# Descriptions
@@ 1
Everyone in the area of effect who is aligned with the caster (GM’s
discretion) subtracts 5 from all elemental attacks against them. They may also
add 5 to all RRs versus spells. These bonuses are not conferred to the caster.
@@ 2
Creates a bright aura about the caster, making him appear more powerful and
subtracting 10 from all attacks against him.
@@ 3
Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a
normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.), except it does
not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a “real” shield.
@@ 4
Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This aubtracts 10 from all
attacks directed at the target.
@@ 5
Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits
before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.
@@ 6
As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 10.
@@ 7
Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 10' of him (caster must
be able to see the missile). This cause 100 to be subtracted from the
missile’s attack.
@@ 8
As Aura, except it makes the caster appear very powerful; subtracting 15 from
all attacks against him.
@@ 9
Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range).
This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.
@@ 10
As Unpain I, except an additional 50% can be sustained.
@@ 11
As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 15.
@@ 12
As Deflections I, except will deflect up to two missiles.
@@ 13
Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 100' of him (caster must
be able to see the missile). This causes the missile to automatically miss.
@@ 14
As Bladeturn I, except affects 2 attacks.
@@ 15
As Unpain I, except an additional 75% can be sustained.
@@ 16
As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 20.
@@ 17
As Deflections I, except will deflect up to three missiles.
@@ 18
As Aim Untrue I, except affects up to two missiles.
@@ 19
As Bladeturn I, except affects 3 attacks.
@@ 20
As Unpain I, except an additional 100% can be sustained.
@@ 25
As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 25.
@@ 30
As Deflections I, except will deflect one missile per level of the caster.
@@ 50
Caster may use any lower level spell on this list once per round.
